Register a custom single-specimen scorer for this R session

Source: R/singlesample-method-registry.R
register_singlesample_method.Rd

Adds a fit/score pair to [singlesample_method_roster()], [deploy_singlesample()] and [singlesample_score_call()]. Registration is local to the loaded package in this R session. Built-in routes cannot be replaced. Deployment objects retain their resolved custom scorer and strict support flag after a route is replaced or removed.

Usage

register_singlesample_method(
  method_id,
  fit_fn,
  score_fn,
  family = "custom",
  role = "discriminator",
  estimand = "custom single-specimen score",
  strict_support = FALSE,
  audit = TRUE,
  probe = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

unregister_singlesample_method(method_id)

registered_singlesample_methods()

Arguments

method_id

One syntactically valid R identifier, unused by built-in routes. Existing user routes require `overwrite = TRUE`.

fit_fn

Function declaring `X_train` and `y_train`. Additional arguments must have defaults, except optional deployment inputs `meta_train`, `meta` and `annotation`. `...` is allowed but not required.

score_fn

Function declaring `model`, `X` and `meta = NULL`, returning one finite numeric score per specimen. Additional arguments must have defaults; `...` is allowed. All fitted parameters must be stored in `model`. Scoring must not change the model or depend on other specimens or mutable external state.

family, role, estimand

Non-empty character scalars describing the route. Use `estimand = "within"` to include a route in within-cohort benchmark helpers, or `"transfer"` for transfer routing. The descriptive default is excluded from within-cohort comparisons. Selector eligibility also requires role `"baseline"` or `"discriminator"`.

strict_support

Logical scalar. If `TRUE`, `score_fn` must accept `strict` explicitly or through `...`; scoring passes this flag in both modes. The callback defines its strict feature policy. Otherwise strict requests fail with `STRICT_UNSUPPORTED`.

audit

Logical scalar. If `TRUE`, fit the probe and run [singlesample_assert_row_equivariant()], including its serialized fitted- state immutability check. Both scoring modes are audited when strict support is declared. `FALSE` skips only registration auditing; deployment verification still defaults to `TRUE`.

probe

Optional list with elements `X` (numeric matrix with unique feature names and at least four rows) and `y` (aligned binary 0/1 labels, both classes present), named or supplied in that order. The default has 12 positive-valued specimens and six features named `feature1` through `feature6`. Supply a probe for callbacks requiring a specific panel. Extra fit settings can be captured in a function wrapper with fixed configuration.

overwrite

Logical scalar. Replace an existing user route only after all requested checks pass.

Value

`register_singlesample_method()` returns invisibly `TRUE`. `unregister_singlesample_method()` returns invisibly whether a user route was removed. `registered_singlesample_methods()` returns a data frame in identifier order with roster columns plus `strict_support` and `audited`.

Details

Registration failures are `singlesample_input_error` conditions with codes `REGISTRATION_INVALID_ID`, `REGISTRATION_ID_EXISTS`, `REGISTRATION_INVALID_FUNCTION`, `REGISTRATION_INVALID_ARGUMENT`, or `REGISTRATION_AUDIT_FAILED`. Audit errors retain the original message. Custom scoring uses the deployment input guards. Callback errors use `CUSTOM_SCORER_FAILED`, unless already coded; invalid or non-finite score output uses `CUSTOM_INVALID_SCORES`.

Auditing tests the supplied probe with absolute tolerance 1e-8. It is not a proof for every possible input or evidence of clinical performance. Models with external pointers cannot pass the default serialization audit. Audit fitting preserves the caller's random seed, but callbacks must avoid other external side effects. Re-register routes in each new R session to fit new deployments; saved deployments contain their scorer but still require its dependencies and a self-contained callback environment.

See also

[deploy_singlesample()], [score_specimen()]
